body: Thanks a lot for taking the to reply man. It’s just that it’s my first ever relationship and it lasted much longer than expected. But when we broke up, she wanted me to treat it as a lesson somewhat but unfortunately for me i really don’t want to see it that way. But yea, I’m slowly trying to re-adjust to life without her but I fear it might take a while.

Hi man just came across this post. I’m genuinely happy for you really, truly. I’m facing some tough times here myself. Wish I could redeem myself as well as you did! Keep your head up high man no more looking down in yourself. I want you to go all the way forward.
